subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI display-name override, and should it be CLI-only, persisted config-backed, or auto-derived?
rationale: The change adds public CLI/config-adjacent surface and affects Gateway-visible presence metadata, so automation should not choose naming, persistence, validation, or privacy defaults without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add CLI-only opt-in flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path that affects only Gateway-mode presence for that process and keeps the existing default unchanged.

options.title: Add persisted TUI config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema, docs, tests, and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Decline or defer
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI label until a broader TUI identity and privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-only opt-in flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path that affects only Gateway-mode presence for that process and keeps the existing default unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties steipete to the original Gateway TUI surface and the current `openclaw-tui` label, while the remaining question is product/API shape.
